title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.



The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.*
**Senior Frontend Engineer**
============================


**An overview of this role**
----------------------------



As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you'll solve high\-scope frontend problems and influence your team's technical and product direction. You'll ship moderately sized features with minimal guidance, improve quality and performance, mentor other engineers, and help establish standards for a high\-scale web environment. You'll partner across product, design, backend, and frontend to make sound trade\-offs, communicate clearly, and improve how the team delivers software.



This is an opportunity to shape product experiences and frontend architecture for a global platform while helping define how modern frontend teams use agentic artificial intelligence. You'll apply artificial intelligence\-assisted engineering workflows thoughtfully and help create trustworthy user experiences that incorporate artificial intelligence responsibly in a remote\-first, asynchronous organization.


**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Design and ship moderately sized frontend features and improvements with minimal guidance, making pragmatic architectural choices.
* Turn ambiguous customer and product needs into clear technical plans and intuitive, accessible experiences.
* Advocate for product quality, security, accessibility, performance, maintainability, and operational readiness throughout the development lifecycle.
* Establish and improve practices for frontend architecture, styling, component design, testing, observability, maintainable code, and thoughtful use of artificial intelligence and agentic tools in production engineering work.
* Mentor Associate and Intermediate Engineers, share knowledge, remove technical blockers, and improve team delivery practices.
* Diagnose and prevent frontend performance and reliability issues at scale using observability and production signals, and participate in incident response or on\-call responsibilities under your team's ownership model.
* Design or review independently buildable frontend surfaces and explicit contracts for data, events, authorization, feature flags, error handling, testing, and performance expectations.
* Collaborate with product, design, backend, quality, security, and other teams to deliver cohesive customer outcomes.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------


* Experience applying frontend architecture, browser behavior, testing, accessibility, performance, and maintainability practices in a complex product or platform environment.
* Experience designing or evolving modular frontend boundaries, independently buildable surfaces, component systems, or migration\-safe architectures.
* Experience making pragmatic trade\-offs with product and design partners and turning complex requirements into clear user experiences.
* The ability to lead through technical judgment, collaboration, and clear written communication rather than formal authority.
* Experience mentoring engineers and improving team practices through code review, design review, documentation, or hands\-on collaboration.
* The ability to work effectively in a remote, asynchronous organization by managing priorities, creating clarity, and communicating decisions in writing.
* Practical experience integrating artificial intelligence into a feature, workflow, or engineering process, or evaluating its reliability, security, privacy, and appropriate human oversight.
* Helpful, but not required: experience with Vue, React, Angular, TypeScript, or JavaScript; PostgreSQL, Redis, or object storage; representational state transfer or GraphQL; Kubernetes, Google Kubernetes Engine, Docker, or Google Cloud Platform; Prometheus or Sentry; and Git, GitLab Runner, or GitLab continuous integration and continuous delivery.

**About the team**
------------------



We own core repository capabilities, from Git command\-line operations to web\-based code exploration. Our roadmap includes feature and platform development, improvements to existing capabilities, maintainability, accessibility, performance, and workflows for teams using AI\-assisted development tools.

#### **How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees**


* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave


Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.



**Country Hiring Guidelines:** GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location\-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.


**Privacy Policy:** Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.



GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

**Staff Frontend Engineer**

As a Staff Frontend Engineer on the Core DevOps team, you'll provide technical leadership across your team and adjacent teams. You'll work with product, design, engineering managers, and engineers across product groups to shape product experiences and frontend architecture for a global platform. This includes how teams use agentic artificial intelligence in engineering workflows and user experiences.

* Experience with modular frontend architecture in production, such as package encapsulation, Web Components, frontend islands, runtime composition, or an equivalent architecture.
* Experience creating alignment without formal authority through clear written proposals and decision records.
* Experience balancing user outcomes, delivery speed, technical health, and long\-term platform investment.
* Experience mentoring engineers and shaping standards through code review and documentation, including evaluating and improving artificial\-intelligence\-assisted or agentic engineering workflows.

title: Frontend Software Engineer (100% Remote)
description:
***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***


At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting\-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve\-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.


But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco\-friendly practices in state\-of\-the\-art, geo\-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer\-to\-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting\-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top\-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***


Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.


If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**


As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you’re not just building interfaces—you’re translating AI intelligence into meaningful human experiences. Your work directly impacts how users perceive, trust, and rely on QV.AC, making you essential to the company’s success in the competitive local AI assistant market

**Responsibilities**

* Deliver new features and bug fixes with a focus on reliability, performance, and user satisfaction
* Maintain high codebase quality through consistent coding standards, code reviews, and automated testing
* Design and develop responsive, high\-performance UI and application state ensuring seamless user experiences across platforms
* Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production\-scale applications.
* Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar).
* Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code.
* Solid skillset in testing \& debugging complex frontend applications.
* Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems.
* Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes).
* Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real\-time communication.
* Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management.
* Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc).
* Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech.

**Important information for candidates**  

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third\-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double\-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

title: Principal Software Engineer (React)
description:
**Who We Are**


At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all\-in\-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support.

  

This role will help build the customer\-facing surfaces that define the Bluehost experience for millions of small businesses. We're scaling fast and rebuilding as we go: new architectural patterns, AI\-native features, and a bar for craft that keeps rising. This is a role for a builder who owns outcomes end\-to\-end, moves ideas from concept to production in days rather than sprints, and wants to help redefine how our front\-end systems get built and shipped.

 *This is a Fully Remote Opportunity.*

 **What You'll Do \& How You'll Make Your Mark**

* Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and long\-term roadmap for frontend systems across the platform.
* Lead the design and development of scalable, high\-performance web applications that serve millions of users.
* Conduct architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical deep dives to ensure engineering excellence.
* Mentor senior engineers and raise the overall engineering bar through coaching and technical leadership.
* Own critical production systems and drive operational excellence, observability, security, and reliability.
* Partner with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and senior leadership to align technical strategy with business goals.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve developer productivity and product quality.
* Champion frontend best practices including performance optimization, accessibility, design systems, and reusable component architecture.
* Drive cross\-team initiatives that reduce tech debt, improve CI/CD pipelines, and elevate code quality standards.
* Influence engineering culture by contributing to hiring, onboarding, and establishing technical standards across the organization.
* Represent the engineering team in cross\-functional planning, sprint reviews, and executive stakeholder discussions.

 **Who You Are \& What You'll Need to Succeed**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 12\+ years of hands\-on experience in frontend/full\-stack development, with at least 2 years in a principal, staff, or equivalent technical leadership role.
* Deep understanding of software design principles, architecture patterns, performance optimization, and system reliability.
* Proven track record of leading large\-scale technical initiatives from inception through delivery.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to influence senior technical and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor and grow engineers at multiple levels of seniority.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn and adopt emerging technologies, especially AI\-driven applications and developer tooling.
* Excellent judgment in making trade\-offs between short\-term delivery and long\-term technical health.
* Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and a bias for action in ambiguous situations.
* Passion for building intuitive, user\-friendly digital experiences at scale.

 **Tech Knowledge Required**

* Expert\-level proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
* Deep mastery of React including Hooks, Context API, component lifecycle, state management, routing, Server Components, and reusable component architecture.
* Strong experience with state management and data\-fetching libraries such as Zustand, TanStack Query, and TanStack Router.
* Hands\-on experience designing and maintaining frontend build systems using Webpack, Vite, Turborepo, or similar tooling.
* Deep expertise in mobile\-first web development, cross\-browser compatibility
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, GraphQL, and asynchronous programming patterns.
* Proficiency with Git\-based workflows, branching strategies, and code review processes at scale.
* Extensive experience with testing strategies including unit, integration, and E2E testing using Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright; integrated with CI/CD for continuous quality assurance.
* Experience using and evaluating AI\-powered developer tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar AI coding assistants to accelerate development workflows.
* Expertise in web performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse), accessibility standards (WCAG), and observability (logging, tracing, alerting).
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent) and Agile/Scrum practices.
* Familiarity with micro\-frontend architectures, Module Federation, and design systems.
* Exposure to backend technologies (Node.js, Python) and cloud platforms (OCI) is a strong plus.

 **Why You'll Love Us**

* **We’ve evolved:** We provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work\-from\-home, hybrid, or work\-from\-the\-office environment.
* **Work\-life balance:** Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
* **We celebrate one another’s differences:** We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20\+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with employees globally.
* **We care about you:** At Bluehost, taking care of our employees is our top priority. We make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi\-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community with one domain at a time, one employee at a time.
* **Where can we take you?** We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with Bluehost \#OTOD!
